splash.features.anonymous.title: No Servers
splash.features.anonymous.body_1: There's no backend: nothing is stored anywhere except in the browsers of the people on the board. Deleting a board removes your copy.
splash.features.anonymous.body_2: is publicly available for anyone to verify.
splash.features.simple.title: Simple, Clean & Intuitive
splash.features.simple.body: Our primary design goal is simplicity, we believe that tools should be easy to understand and require no manual.
splash.features.open_source.title: Free & Open Source
splash.features.open_source.body: Retro.tools is free to use and the source code is available on
splash.features.no_logins.title: No sign-up
splash.features.no_logins.body: Nobody needs an account. Share the board link and people can join straight away.
splash.features.encryption.title: Optional password
splash.features.encryption.body_1: Add a password and everything on the board is encrypted in the browser before it leaves your device.
splash.features.encryption.body_2: Everything happens in your browser, and data only ever travels peer-to-peer between participants.
board.votes_remaining_hint: Votes you can still cast on this board

board.peers_hint: Other participants connected directly to you
splash.privacy_note: No servers, no accounts. Boards travel directly between participants' browsers over encrypted peer-to-peer connections and are stored only on your devices.
board.your_name_hint: Shown on cards you add. Leave empty to stay anonymous.
board.waiting.title: Waiting for someone with this board…
board.waiting.body: Boards live only in participants' browsers. As soon as someone who has this board opens it, it will load here. Share the link with them, or ask them to keep the board open.
board.waiting.blocked: Found participants but couldn't connect directly. One of your networks (often a corporate firewall or VPN) is blocking peer-to-peer connections. Try another network, such as a phone hotspot.
board.waiting.blocked_turn: Found participants but couldn't connect, even through the relay. Check your network or VPN.
